title: Who Am I? — Sīrah Edition
dedication: Dedicated to our beloved grandmother Khadidja Aktouf Benmeziane 🤍
yourTurn: 🤔 Try to guess who you are by asking questions!

waraka: Cousin of Khadija bint Khuwaylid, the Prophet’s ﷺ wife.
A Christian scholar who read Hebrew scriptures.
The first to believe in the Prophet ﷺ after revelation.
Said: 'Would that I were young when your people drive you out.'
He died shortly after the first revelation.
khadija: The Prophet’s ﷺ first wife and mother of his children.
One of the most respected and wealthy women of Quraysh.
The first to believe in the Prophet’s message.
Supported him financially and emotionally in early Islam.
Given glad tidings of a palace in Paradise by Angel Jibril.
abu_bakr: The first man to embrace Islam.
The Prophet’s ﷺ companion during the migration to Madinah.
Spent much of his wealth in support of Islam.
Freed oppressed Muslim slaves like Bilal.
The first caliph after the Prophet’s ﷺ death.
umar: Converted after years of secret preaching.
The Prophet ﷺ prayed: 'O Allah, strengthen Islam with ʿUmar.'
Known for justice and strength in truth.
Oversaw massive Islamic expansion as caliph.
The second caliph, martyred while praying.
bilal: An Abyssinian slave who embraced Islam early.
He endured torture while repeating: 'Ahad, Ahad' (One, One).
The first muezzin (caller to prayer) in Islam.
The Prophet ﷺ loved his voice and said: 'Relieve us with it, O Bilal.'
salman: Undertook a long journey in search of truth.
Converted from Christianity and joined the Prophet ﷺ in Madinah.
Suggested digging a trench during the Battle of the Trench.
The Prophet ﷺ said: 'Salman is one of us, the people of the household.'
He became a model of knowledge, piety, and endurance.

howToPlaySteps: Create a team or join an existing one by entering the team code.
Wait for all players to join. The host can then start the game.
Each player is assigned a Sīrah character and must guess who they are by asking yes/no questions.
During your turn, you can’t see your own character; others see it and validate if your guess is right.
The game ends when everyone has guessed. The fastest correct guesser wins!
